description: Approved on the fz-sc8.66 page. Today a root waiting in a receive with no after, with nothing runnable and no timer pending, exits 0 with no message on interp, run and build. Elixir hangs forever. fz knows for certain the program can make no progress. Done when: on all three paths this reports a runtime error naming the waiting receive, with a non-zero exit, using the shared idle definition from fz-sc8.66; a fixture pins the message and exit code.
title: A program whose main process can never wake is a loud runtime error
